g.text: Transitions managed by LuxoStateMachine with callbacks
Modes: wakeup, listen, think, direction, arc
SNR analysis, adaptive noise floor, directional tracking, voice confidence
Features: Speed control, interruption handling, collision integration, state awareness
Emotion mappings: Happy->excited, Sad->sad, Surprised->startled, Angry->shake
Features: Face tracking, distance measurement, emotion history, framebuffer display
Detection zones: Warning (slow), Danger (stop), Persistent (escape), Extended (home)
Command types: Joint control, DEMA toggle, Light control, Servo parameters
Safety features: Joint limits, acceleration limits, collision override, state validation
Allows manual positioning, auto-resumes after movement
Sensors -> Detection -> State Machine -> Avoidance -> Joint Override
Mic Array -> Direction -> NeoPixel + Base Rotation
• Voice detection with directional tracking and NeoPixel visualization
• State machine with 9 distinct states and transition callbacks
• Command infrastructure with JSON protocol and queueing
• Touch sensor integration for physical interaction
• DEMA torque tuning and touch integration
